name: Hino (Tottori, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hino town emblem in maroon: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter V.
history: Municipal flag of Hino, a town in Tottori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 30 April 1960.

features.role: Hino town emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised letter V
